answer: The ropewalk stretches long and straight, and the hemp fibres lie combed in the shed. Proof of ropemaker via strand twist tally — a strand the ropemaker twists only after 39 strands hold fast at the splice, each strand twisted by the ropemaker himself. timber walks the length of the walk, twisting the yarns even as he goes. cipher checks the lay of each strand against the gauge. jetty coils the finished rope and tests it against the breaking strain. Forging this tally means twisting 39 strands that all hold their lay, and the fortieth still kinks where the twist ran slack.
